last_lines.page/paragraph#2: N: On the road home a woman met them beside a heap of bundles. "You sent her here," Delamere told the Commander. "I chose her. Now she has to move her hearth again." She took up the first bundle. The woman followed her, cursing, and Delamere answered every word.
last_lines.page/paragraph#3: N: At Drezen the camp carts blocked the well path. Delamere halted the Commander there. "You kept them here. Make your captain clear it." When the carts moved she went back to her temple; the city still stank, even after that night.
last_lines.page/paragraph#4: N: Two of Drezen's elders were disputing the same patch beside the well when the lovers came down the road. Delamere put her bow between them. "I chose you both. I will hear you both." The Commander waited beside her while they marked a passage in the mud.
